senses.gloss: (b. h. הֲלֹם; cmp. הָלָא)here, hither; thus far.
units: Zeb. 102ᵃ (play on הָלַם, q. v.) אין ה׳ אלא מלכות hălom alludes to royalty, as we read (II Sam. VII, 18) &c. עד ה׳ thus far (to be king).
Ib. וכל היכא דכתיב ה׳ וכ׳ does hălom in the Bible always intimate royalty for all time to come?
